text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated "errors" and 'corrupted outputs' detected on inference pool redwood-rt-3 (KV cache reuse metric spiked). Auto-page issued (PD ticket #PD-8921).

 alex (oncall): I'm on it. Paging SRE + eng-runtime. severity=P1. Anyone oncall?

 pd-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-8921 acknowledged by alex (oncall). Escalation to maria (eng-runtime) in 4m.

 maria (eng-runtime): joining. any customer reports?

 sophie (support): multiple customers reported wrong completions that included prior session context. Ticketed a few with sample transcripts — sending sanitized examples in a DM.

 ryan (sre): seeing 5xx spike *and* a small % of responses where the prefix tokens look like they're from other requests. logs show mismatched seq offsets when reusing KV frames.

 alex (oncall): rough repro log snippet:
 ```
 [2026-03-14T10:12:07Z] req_id=abc123 model=gptx-13b pool=redwood-rt-3 kv_reuse=true seq_offset=42 returned_seq=7
 [2026-03-14T10:12:07Z] req_id=def456 model=gptx-13b pool=redwood-rt-3 kv_reuse=true seq_offset=7 returned_seq=42
 ```

 maria (eng-runtime): that pattern matches a reuse correctness bug — keys from one request reattached to a different seq base. suspect regression from last batching patch that changed key rotation and pool ordering.

 devon (infra): we just rolled continuous-batching v2.3.1 last night to reduce latency. Can we revert quickly?

 alex (oncall): proposed live mitigations: 1) disable KV reuse flag on affected pools; 2) roll back continuous-batching config to previous safe commit; 3) enable verbose KV logging for canary. Anyone object?

 ryan (sre): +1. disabling KV reuse reduces throughput but eliminates cross-request leakage immediately. I'll run the disable now.

 ryan (sre): /run: curl -XPOST https://internal-api/pools/redwood-rt-3/config -d '{"kv_reuse":false}'

 oncall-bot: Action logged: KV reuse disabled on pool redwood-rt-3 by ryan.

 maria (eng-runtime): starting canary verification on a subset of traffic. will watch for stale key errors and validation tests.

 sophie (support): notifying affected customers we're investigating and applying mitigations. low risk of data exposure; we recommend app teams to avoid long-tail session mixing until cleared. message draft posted in #customer-comm-drafts. :wave: 

 alex (oncall): rolling back continuous-batching config to commit c3b9f (previous stable). devon, can infra push the rollback?

 devon (infra): rolling back now. watching deploys. estimated 3-5m to propagate.

 oncall-bot: Deploy: rollback continuous-batching -> c3b9f started by devon. CI checks passing.

 maria (eng-runtime): adding quick validation: run 1000 synthetic requests with randomized session IDs; assert no cross-session tokens in outputs.

 maria (eng-runtime): validation harness output:
 ```
 1000/1000 requests: no cross-session token leakage detected. 0/1000 corrupted outputs.
 latency delta +6% after disabling kv reuse.
 ```

 ryan (sre): infra reports errors back down to baseline after rollback. on-call metrics: error-rate now within SLO.

 sophie (support): updated customers: hotfix applied, rollback done, monitoring in place. requests for follow-up postmortem — sending timeline + impact summary.

 alex (oncall): handing off to maria for root-cause and postmortem. i'll be available for escalation. handoff at 10:22Z. :eyes: 

 maria (eng-runtime): ack. initial RCA hypothesis: a change in the continuous-batching scheduler changed the ordering of sub-batches. when combined with an optimization that caches KV frames keyed by (pool, shard, slot) instead of (req_id, seq_base), some frames were reused with an incorrect seq_base leading to wrong KV offsets. regression introduced in PR #4872.

 maria (eng-runtime): immediate follow-ups:
 - revert PR #4872 in staging and add unit tests for seq_base alignment (blocked sequences).
 - add end-to-end test that simulates parallel batches with overlapping sequence ranges.
 - add a metric `kv_reuse_seq_mismatch_count` and an alert at >1/min.
 - add a canary that validates session isolation at pre-prod scale.

 devon (infra): noted. I'll pin the safe config to stable until tests merge.

 ryan (sre): propose we also add a runtime guard: if seq_base mismatch detected when fetching KV, drop reuse and log an anomaly (count it). lowers perf but prevents leakage.

 maria (eng-runtime): agreed. will ship guard: check seq_base equality before reuse; fallback to cold load otherwise. target patch in next 2 hrs.

 sophie (support): impact summary for PMs/CS: ~14 customers had anomalous completions in a 16m window; ~3 had sensitive-style context echoes (low probability). No known PII leakage confirmed. we've prioritized outreach.

 pd-bot: PD incident PD-8921 status -> mitigated. current severity -> reduced to P2; awaiting postmortem.

 alex (oncall): thanks all. write a postmortem doc, include timeline, blame-free analysis, code pointers to PR #4872, test plan, and owners: maria (RCA+fix), ryan (runtime guard + alerting), devon (config pin + rollback steps), sophie (customer comms).

 maria (eng-runtime): creating postmortem draft in docs/incidents/PD-8921-kv-reuse.json. will request review in 24h.

 ryan (sre): added quick dashboard panels: kv_reuse_rate, kv_seq_mismatch_count, corrupted_output_rate. will keep elevated retention for 48h.

 alex (oncall): closing the page — monitoring for 2h, if nothing resurfaces we'll fully close. great speedy work. :thumbsup:
